CVE-2026-135479.title: Merchant for WooCommerce before 2.3.3 Missing Authorization via Quick View AJAX
CVE-2026-135479.description: Merchant for WooCommerce before 2.3.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Quick View module that allows unauthenticated attackers to read draft, pending, private, and scheduled WooCommerce products. The modal_content_ajax_callback() handler for the merchant_quick_view_content AJAX action is registered for unauthenticated users, is gated only by the merchant-nonce value exposed to every front-end visitor, and loads any supplied product_id with wc_get_product() without checking the product's post status or the user's read_post capability. Attackers can iterate product IDs to obtain the title, price, description, gallery images, and SKU of unpublished products when the Quick View module is enabled.

CVE-2026-76822.description: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. This issue is fixed in version 7.260701.0.
